headline: Counting FWABs and ballots mailed from outside the United States for the November 3, 2026 State Election.
summary: Ballots must have been postmarked by November 3, 2026 and received by parcel post by the November 13, 2026 5:00 p.m. deadline (MGL c. 54, §95). The meeting will be canceled if a quorum is reached at a November 13, 2026 meeting at 5:15 p.m.

# Board of Registrars Meeting

**Tuesday, November 17, 2026**

**9:00 a.m.**

**Kyrouz Auditorium**

**9 Dale Avenue**

**Gloucester, MA 01930**

***NOTE: This meeting will be cancelled if the Board of Registrars holds its meeting at 5:15 p.m. on Friday, November 13, 2026. It is being posted as an alternative date in the event that the Board fails to reach a quorum at its November 13, 2026 meeting.***

The public is welcome to attend in person. Zoom link to access the meeting remotely is also available.

Join from Computer, Smart Device: https://gloucester-ma-gov.zoom.us/j/81014334442

Join via Phone: 1 309 205 3325

Meeting ID: 810 1433 4442

## AGENDA

1. Approval of Minutes from September 22, 2026

2. Counting FWABs and ballots mailed from outside of the United States for the November 3, 2026 State Election postmarked by November 3, 2026 and received by parcel post on or before the November 13, 2026 5:00 p.m. deadline (MGL c. 54, §95)

The listing of matters is those reasonably anticipated by the Chair, which may be discussed at the meeting. Not all items listed may in fact be discussed and other items not listed may also be brought up for discussion to the extent permitted by law.
